title: Local model install catalog

context.summary: Add a canonical catalog for local model runners used by installer and model-profile work.
context.background: TASK-121 made the self-host gate explicit. The next release-readiness block needs structured metadata for installable local model runners before Compose profiles and installer auto-install flows can consume it.

in: Cover text embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision captioning, image embeddings, face detection and face recognition.
Record image/source, model files, license/status, ports, healthchecks and CPU/RAM/disk/GPU hints for each runner.
Add validation that the catalog covers required roles and public docs.
Document the local model catalog and link it from LLM/installer docs.

acceptance_criteria: The catalog covers TEXT_EMBEDDING, IMAGE_EMBEDDING, OCR, ASR, VISION_CAPTIONING, FACE_DETECTION and FACE_RECOGNITION.
Every catalog entry includes source or image metadata, model file metadata, license/status, ports, healthcheck and resource hints.
docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md documents every catalog entry and required role coverage.
pnpm local-models:validate, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md does not claim model containers are started by default.

risks: Upstream model licenses and resource needs vary by deployment and must stay visible in the catalog.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
